# lamejs 1.2.1

MP3 encoder used by the karaoke maker lab (js/media/mp3-worker.js).

- `lame.all.js` is copied unmodified from the npm package `lamejs@1.2.1`
  (https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs), a JavaScript port of LAME
  (https://lame.sourceforge.io).
- Licence: GNU LGPL 3.0 (https://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.html), see
  `LICENSE` for the LAME project's notes. It is loaded as a separate file,
  never bundled or changed; to upgrade it, replace the file.
